ms.promise:
Building an online channel to promote the discussion and interaction of the community: Updating information, discussion, and sharing of knowledge about Cardano.
1. Stage 1: From October 1, 2023 - November 30, 2023
・Contact speakers, arrange schedule and topics for each session for 6 months
・Complete report form then share to public
・Marketing to community about project to Facebook, Telegram, YouTube
・Organize 5 sessions of development news of the Cardano ecosystem
・Publish 5 videos on YouTube then share via Telegram group
ms.criteria:
・Organized 5 online livestream sessions on the Zoom platform
・Save and share videos via Telegram, YouTube within 24 hours after each online session.
・Time: October - November 2023;
・Target viewer

・Zoom: more than 100 live viewers for each session.
・YouTube: At least 500 views within 10 days and more than 2000 views within two months after being published. 
・Telegram: All members will be informed about livestream and more than 300 views the post of video within 7 days.
